limits.description: List of resource limit entries to configure for users or groups.

domain.description: User name, group (prefixed with @), or wildcard (*).

type.description: Limit type: 'hard' (enforced), 'soft' (current limit, can be raised by user up to hard limit).

item.description: Resource to limit (e.g., nofile, nproc, memlock, rtprio, rlimit_as).
